title: Clicking or pressing Enter on a blocked item does nothing
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Have the shop's own active term A, due 14 days after the invoice date, held by one customer.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click the greyed "Edit".
  3. Press the Down arrow key until "Delete Credit Term" is highlighted.
  4. Press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens with "Edit" and "Delete Credit Term" greyed.

Step 2:

  • Nothing happens: no window opens and the menu stays open.

Step 3:

  • "Delete Credit Term" is highlighted.

Step 4:

  • Nothing happens: no confirmation opens and the menu stays open.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-N6: “Clicking or pressing Enter on a blocked item does nothing and keeps the menu open.”
  • S2-R1: “Each row's "⋯" menu shows only the items that apply to that term, in this order. An item that applies but is blocked shows greyed out and does nothing when clicked; hovering it shows the reason.”
